div.style: color: rgb(19, 38, 61) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
POST /chat · question + session_id
load the last 6 question/answer pairs (SQLite)

div.style: color: rgb(61, 42, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
1 · Build the request
system prompt · history · question
5 strict tool schemas + ModelAnswer schema (both from Pydantic)
prompt cache · effort low · thinking summary

div.style: color: rgb(59, 20, 20) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 · Call Claude Sonnet 5.5 · Messages API
structured output · server-side refusal fallbacks

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: stop_reason

div.style: color: rgb(61, 42, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3 · Run the requested tools (in parallel)
validate arguments → invalid: error back to the model
identical call in this question → served from cache

div.style: color: rgb(20, 48, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
Deterministic engine
rank_hubs · explain_hub · compare_hubs · hub_breakdown · weather_stat
results: numbers, pre-computed differences, caveats, method, scoring run

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
limit
reached?

div.style: color: rgb(61, 42, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
4 · Guardrail
after 2 successful tool rounds, a round of only repeated calls,
or on the 6th model call → next call with tool_choice: none
(tools stay defined, prompt cache intact)

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
valid
JSON?

div.style: color: rgb(61, 42, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ask again with the
validation error (once)

div.style: color: rgb(61, 42, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
5 · Attach engine data
answer + assumptions + confidence + uncertainty + sources (from the model)
+ ranking from rank_hubs, tool calls, tokens, trajectory (from the code)

div.style: color: rgb(19, 38, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
6 · Save and return
turn → SQLite · trajectory → JSON file · AgentAnswer → the page

refusal · max_tokens · API error
